_comment: Which Red Hat advisories go into which README. cves: shown in full, or summarized when a CVE has more than 20 advisories and the README has no focus; summary: shown as counts only; point: a CVE whose advisories are listed in another README; focus: a package pattern listed first, and the only ones listed for a CVE with many advisories; matrix: the kernel layout; note: one sentence about what the advisories are for; label: how other READMEs name this one.
_excluded_why: The main README points at the index document. GitLab only cites the Ruby flaws, and Omnibus GitLab bundles its own Ruby.
_known_outside_window_why: January advisories the vsftpd README names, before the Red Hat list starts.

system/brotli/README.md.note: Firefox, Thunderbird and other packages that bundle the Brotli decoder carry the same CVE; they are counted, not listed.
system/brotli/README.md.label: Brotli

servers/haproxy/README.md.note: The only advisory is for a 3.0 build, although HAProxy gives 3.1 as the first affected line: `check` says so for a 3.0 build that is a Red Hat one.

developer/jenkins/README.md.note: These are the OpenShift Jenkins images, not the RHEL packages.

system/openssl/README.md.note: Other packages that bundle OpenSSL carry the same CVE; they are counted, not listed.

system/pki/README.md.note: This is the Go standard library flaw named above, so the advisories are for Go programs, not for the certificate store.

developer/storybook/README.md.note: Red Hat's advisories for this CVE are for Grafana, not for a package called Storybook.

developer/nextjs/README.md.note: The only advisory is for a Trusted Artifact Signer container image that bundles the affected code, not for a Next.js or sharp package; `check` reads the project's own lockfiles.

developer/django/README.md.note: These are Red Hat products that bundle Django (Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Discovery and ansible-creator), not a RHEL python-django package.

developer/jupyter/README.md.note: These are OpenShift AI container images that bundle the affected Jupyter code, not RHEL packages.

runtimes/java/README.md.note: These are the OpenJDK 17, 21 and 25 builds for RHEL 8, 9 and 10 and for the Hummingbird images.

system/apt/README.md.note: The only advisory is for the apt package in Red Hat's Hummingbird images; RHEL itself does not use APT.

servers/apache/README.md.note: Red Hat ships HTTP/2 support as the separate mod_http2 package; the JBoss Core Services and Dev Spaces advisories are for builds that bundle their own httpd.
